name: Batched2DRopePositionEncodingBackward
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_cos, grad_sin, idx_theta):
    sin_theta = torch.sin(idx_theta)
    cos_theta = torch.cos(idx_theta)
    grad_cos_f32 = grad_cos.to(torch.float32)
    grad_sin_f32 = grad_sin.to(torch.float32)
    grad_idx_theta = -grad_cos_f32 * sin_theta + grad_sin_f32 * cos_theta
    return grad_idx_theta
description: Backward pass for batched 2D rotary position encoding. Computes gradient w.r.t. idx_theta from grad_cos and grad_sin. Pure PyTorch: reverse rotary transform gradient computation.
